sn45.114:1.2: the Ganges, Yamunā, Aciravatī, Sarabhū, and Mahī, all of them slant, slope, and incline to the ocean;
sn45.114:1.3: In the same way, a mendicant who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.
sn45.114:1.4: And how does a mendicant who develops the noble eightfold path slant, slope, and incline to extinguishment?
sn45.114:1.5: It’s when a mendicant develops right view, which culminates in the removal of greed, hate, and delusion … develops right concentration, which culminates in the removal of greed, hate, and delusion.
sn45.114:1.6: That’s how a mendicant who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.”
sn45.114:1.8: (The second set of twelve, with the abandoning of passion, inclines to the ocean.)
